home.title: Storage
home.noAdminBody: Scans use the slower folder walk, and some system folders stay hidden.
home.noDrives: Lustro found no fixed or USB drives.

admin.dialogBody1: Windows shows a User Account Control prompt. Then Lustro restarts with admin rights.
admin.dialogBody2: With admin rights you get the fast scan, live updates, system folders and the system cleaner.
admin.cancelled: Lustro still runs without admin rights. You cancelled the Windows prompt.
admin.failed: Lustro could not restart as administrator: {{error}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: System follows the Windows light or dark setting.
settings.aboutHint: Free and open source (MIT). Lustro is Latin for “I purify” and “I survey”.

soon.title: {{screen}} is not ready yet
soon.body: This part of Lustro comes in milestone {{milestone}}. Follow the progress on GitHub.
